Meal plans for working professionals in Dubai

By the Messify team · Updated November 2026 · 3 min read

Quick answer

For working professionals in Dubai, a meal plan replaces three daily food decisions with one choice made ahead. Messify plans cost AED 715 a month for lunch only, AED 1,400 for lunch and dinner, or AED 1,999 for all three meals (AED 25.63 a meal). Meals arrive packed cold at home or the office, and you can skip days you travel.

Also feeding the whole office for an event? We cater team lunches, town halls and celebrations too: corporate event catering. Planning a National Day celebration for your team?

The working week, food edition

Breakfast skipped or grabbed on the way. Lunch ordered at 1 PM along with everyone else in the building. Dinner decided at 9 PM, delivered at 10. For a lot of working professionals in Dubai, that's every weekday: three food decisions a day, three delivery fees, and meals that depend on how busy the day was.

A meal plan removes the decisions. You choose your meals ahead, they arrive packed cold, and the only thing left to do is reheat. This guide covers which plan suits which working pattern, what it costs and how to make it fit your week.

Which plan suits your week

  • Office five days, social weekends: 1 meal a day for lunch at work. Monthly at AED 715 (AED 27.50 a meal).
  • Long days, cooking is not happening: 2 meals a day for lunch and dinner. Monthly at AED 1,400 (AED 26.92 a meal).
  • Every meal sorted: 3 meals a day, breakfast included. Monthly at AED 1,999 (AED 25.63 a meal), the lowest price per meal.
  • Not sure yet: try a weekly plan from AED 215, then switch to monthly.

How it fits around work

  1. Choose your meals ahead in the Messify app. The menu changes every day, and orders are placed at least a day ahead.
  2. Your meals arrive packed cold in a Messify bag with an ice pack, at home or at the office.
  3. Keep them in the fridge and reheat for a few minutes when you're ready.
  4. Skip days you don't need. Travelling for work or out for dinner? Every meal is a token you can use later in your plan.

Is it worth it compared with ordering in?

If you order in most working days, a meal plan usually costs less per meal once delivery and service fees are counted, and it removes the daily decision. Put your own numbers into our meal plan vs ordering in calculator to see the difference over a month.

Office lunch for the team

If colleagues want lunch sorted too, teams can share one monthly plan with one delivery for everyone, and each person picks their own meals. Employers can also cover it as a staff benefit: see staff meal plans for companies.

Where Messify delivers for working professionals

  • Dubai Silicon Oasis and Dubai Festival City, offices and homes
  • Jebel Ali and JAFZA, Dubai Investments Park and Dubai South, offices, sites and homes
  • Al Furjan, International City, Al Aweer and Academic City

Every meal is 100% halal, with a vegetarian option every day, for every meal. See all plans on our meal plans in Dubai page, or start your plan.

Questions people ask

What is the best meal plan for working professionals in Dubai?

It depends on your week. Lunch only suits office days; lunch and dinner suits long days; 3 meals a day gives the lowest price per meal. With Messify that is AED 715, 1,400 or 1,999 a month.

Can I get my meal plan delivered to the office?

Yes. Messify delivers to offices and homes in its delivery areas. Meals arrive packed cold, ready for the office fridge.

What if I travel for work?

Skip those days in the app and use the meals later in your plan. Monthly plans give you 30 days to use 26 days of meals.

Can I order on the same day?

No. Messify orders are always placed at least a day ahead.

Does a meal plan cost less than ordering in?

If you order in most working days, a meal plan usually costs less per meal once delivery and service fees are counted. Use our calculator to check with your own numbers.
